inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A close piece of a pixel art battle stage background: a warm afternoon sky of pale gold haze and soft clouds, a big pale sun, the tops of two dark stone pillars at the bottom. In it, far off: a colossal sacred scarab beetle the size of a hill, its dark corroded bronze shell catching the light, pushing the sun across the sky with its hind legs, its head down, seen from the side, a wild animal, in the same pixel art, colours and light as everything around it. Rendered entirely in crisp, deliberately clustered pixel art. Modern high quality pixel art like Sea of Stars: bright, colourful and readable, never muddy.", "style_description": {"medium": "pixel_art", "art_style": "Authentic hand pixelled 2D game battle stage background. Visible square pixel clusters and stair stepped contours everywhere. Flat colour clusters, two to four shades per material. Crisp pixel edges without antialiasing. Clean readable shapes. No paint brushwork, no gradients except a dithered sky, no noise texture.", "aesthetics": "one coherent pixel art scene, coherent pixel clusters, a clear readable creature, everything lit by the same light", "lighting": "Warm late afternoon sun from high on the right, short soft shadows, as discrete flat pixel colour planes, the ground in calm even light.", "color_palette": ["#3a78c8", "#9cc8ec", "#f8d890", "#f0a850", "#b0443a", "#6a2a2a", "#e4d8c8", "#c0b0a0", "#3e302c", "#7a6250", "#96703e", "#f07828"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "a warm afternoon sky of pale gold haze and soft clouds, a big pale sun, the tops of two dark stone pillars at the bottom", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [187, 156, 700, 515], "desc": "a colossal sacred scarab beetle the size of a hill, its dark corroded bronze shell catching the light, pushing the sun across the sky with its hind legs, its head down, seen from the side, a wild animal, facing left, its head down, its hind legs pressed against the sun's edge"}]}}
